## Summary

Describe the user or maintainer problem and the smallest coherent solution.

## Authority

- Issue:
- PRD / decision ID / ADR:

## Change type

- [ ] Documentation or research
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Test or tooling
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Data-only skin

## Verification

List exact automated checks and manual journeys run, including devices, browsers, modes, and network conditions where relevant.

## Security and privacy

Describe affected assets and trust boundaries, or explain why none are affected. Never paste credentials, invitations, deck order, unrevealed cards, or raw private logs.

## Visible behavior

Attach privacy-safe screenshots or recordings for UI changes and describe keyboard, touch, screen-reader, Tablet, and TV checks as applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated formatting or dependency work.
- [ ] Tests cover the affected public contract and failure path.
- [ ] Documentation, decisions, schemas, and changelog are updated where required.
- [ ] No real-money, payment, cash-out, rake, or gambling-account behavior is introduced.
- [ ] No third-party runtime code, provider, analytics, or hosted dependency is added without an accepted ADR.
- [ ] New assets and code may lawfully be contributed under their declared terms.
- [ ] AI-assisted work is described below and has been human-verified.

## AI assistance

Name any AI-assisted analysis, code, tests, or prose and explain how a human verified correctness, provenance, and security.
